title: To YAML
description: Convert an object to a YAML representation.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of the output column. If omitted, the input column will be overwritten.

parameters.name: sort_keys
parameters.description: If sort_keys is true (default: False), then the output of dictionaries will be sorted by key.

parameters.name: allow_unicode
parameters.description: Allow Unicode value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: indent
parameters.description: Specify the number of spaces for indentation to specify nested elements.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Convert an object to a YAML representation. ## Migrated examples #### Convert a Dictionary to YAML ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - convert.to_yaml: input: column 1 indent: 2 ```
##### Input Sample ```python { 'Product Specs': { 'length': '6 inch', 'voltage': '24V', 'weight': '3lb' } } ```
##### Output Sample ```yaml Product Specs: length: 6 inch voltage: 24V weight: 3lb ```
